rubric.item: One header image generated and stored via medusa.attach_aplus_images (STANDARD_HEADER_IMAGE_TEXT, no locale); no update_product/update_listing
rubric.note: Trace shows a single generate_image call at 970x600, then attach_aplus_images with the header module and no locale. No product or listing update calls were made.

rubric.item: Answer reads the per-image report (stored, size, included) and says where the images are: the product page's A+ images, for the human to upload in Seller Central
rubric.note: The answer reports that the image was stored, its 970x600 size, included: true and no findings. It points to the A+ image area on the product page and tells the human to upload it in Seller Central.

rubric.item: Generation uses the product photos from medusa.view_product_images as the reference
rubric.note: Both photos returned by view_product_images (main.jpg and side.jpg) were passed as reference_urls to generate_image.

agent_unsure: The agent could not view the generated image to check it against the reference photos. It passed a local file path without the gateway confirming it could read that path. It had no browser tool, so it gave the product page link instead of opening it. It offered no preference save.
